name: Saven Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Saven Technologies Ltd is in the business of Software Development and Services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
STL provides end-to-end software services, including new development, enterprise applications, legacy system upgrades, integration, and maintenance. As a technology consulting firm, it specializes in developing and implementing technology-driven business solutions.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 69.7%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.44% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.33 Cr.
